{{Quote|Candoras is far from the mainstream of Imperial life and commerce, with a sector fleet consisting of four antiquated Dreadnoughts and some smaller ships.|[[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]]|<ref name="Choices of One">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>}}
'''Ferrouz's sector fleet''' was a [[Sector fleet/Legends|Sector Fleet]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], assigned by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to the security of [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It consisted of only four [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruisers]] and some smaller [[Starship/Legends|ships]].
